title: Panspermia
description: Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

puzzle.goal: Spores ride inside a rock between worlds for time t. Radiation at dose rate R is attenuated by the rock (absorption coefficient μ, depth x), and a spore dies only when all m of its sensitive targets are hit, each target surviving a dose D with probability exp(−D/D0). Write the surviving fraction after the journey.
puzzle.name: Multi-target survival model (radiation dose)
puzzle.form: 1 - ( 1 - exp ( - int ( 0 , t , R * exp ( - μ * x ) , s ) / D _ 0 ) ) ^ m
puzzle.ask: With a constant dose rate the dose is R·t·e^(−μx). Find how many of N0 spores survive, with shielding μx = k.
puzzle.method: Accumulate the dose by integrating the shielded dose rate over time; a target survives with exp(−D/D0), and the spore dies only if every target is hit.
